01 Bio

Brandon Arrington

"I'm a professional MMA fighter and experienced coach specializing in boxing, Muay Thai, Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, wrestling, and fitness training. I work with adults and kids of all experience levels, from total beginners to experienced athletes. And my goal is to provide practical, challenging training that's tailored to each client's goals."

Background

I have six years of coaching experience and have trained and competed in mixed martial arts for over 15 years, with more than 20 years of martial arts experience overall. As a coach, I currently work with two championship fighters and help athletes build skill, conditioning, and confidence. Along with my coaching background, I also have five years of personal training experience, helping clients improve their strength, fitness, conditioning, and overall performance.

Coaching philosophy

I meet clients where they are and build step-by-step plans focused on fundamentals, smart progression, and measurable wins. We emphasize clean technique, consistency, and recovery so you get results without burning out. The goal is steady progress you can feel and sustain. If that works for you, we can paste it in and walk through how to explain it.
